svg.title: self-defending-portfolio: architecture overview
svg.desc: The network path from the visitor through Cloudflare and an outbound-only tunnel to the Cilium Gateway and the page with its API; GitOps from a push through CI and Argo CD; the supply chain from the build workflow through Trivy, keyless cosign signing and GHCR to Kyverno admission; detection and response from a sandbox pod through Falco, Falcosidekick and Falco Talon back to kube-apiserver, and from everything to the SIEM on its own VM.
svg.text: Generated from app/web/src/diagram/model.ts (npm run diagram); the same model draws the live diagram on the site. Details and sources: docs/architecture/README.md

svg.title: self-defending-portfolio: architecture overview
svg.desc: The network path from the visitor through Cloudflare and an outbound-only tunnel to the Cilium Gateway and the page with its API; GitOps from a push through CI and Argo CD; the supply chain from the build workflow through Trivy, keyless cosign signing and GHCR to Kyverno admission; detection and response from a sandbox pod through Falco, Falcosidekick and Falco Talon back to kube-apiserver, and from everything to the SIEM on its own VM.

g.text: one VM · Ansible-hardened · nftables input drop · Cilium
GitOps: every cluster change is a commit
Supply chain: only our own images, only if signed on main
Detection and response: no human in the loop, sandbox only

svg.text: Box colour: the node's role. Solid line: the main path of a request, an action or an artefact. Dotted: a side relationship. Green: the automatic response.

Falco rules: a terminal shell, a sensitive file read, a dropped binary, execution from the shop volume → terminate (grace 0); a network tool → quarantine (a label selects a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy that denies all ingress and egress).
Proof: tests/runtime/run.sh asserts alert → POST → terminate, the quarantine and Talon's RBAC limits; tests/scenarios/run.sh runs every scenario; siem/ holds the Sigma rules and the correlations.
